title: Pago aprobado con 4242 muestra Pago confirmado, total y descarga
description: Real checkout with approved card 4242 4242 4242 4242 must land on the success page with confirmation, total and download link. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button with data-testid=btn-agregar on the card for 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla)
Navigate to /carrito and click the button with data-testid=btn-pagar (accessible name 'Pagar con Stripe')
On the hosted Stripe Checkout page fill email test@example.com, card number 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12 / 34, CVC 123, cardholder name 'Test User', then submit the payment
Verify the URL contains /exito?session_id=
Verify the element data-testid=mensaje-exito is visible and contains the text 'Pago confirmado'
Verify the page shows 'Total: $15.00'
Verify a link whose accessible name starts with 'Descargar' (e.g. 'Descargar Kubernetes Cluster Overview') is visible
Navigate to /carrito and verify data-testid=contador-carrito shows '(0)'

title: Compra completa con 4242 y verificación de la página de éxito
description: Complete a real purchase of one template and verify the success page content. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button with data-testid=btn-agregar on the card for 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla)
Navigate to /carrito and click the button with data-testid=btn-pagar (accessible name 'Pagar con Stripe')
On the hosted Stripe Checkout page fill email test@example.com, card number 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12 / 34, CVC 123, cardholder name 'Test User', then submit the payment
Verify the URL contains /exito?session_id=
Verify the element data-testid=mensaje-exito is visible and contains the text 'Pago confirmado'
Verify the page shows 'Total: $15.00'
Verify a link whose accessible name starts with 'Descargar' (e.g. 'Descargar Kubernetes Cluster Overview') is visible

title: Revisar el carrito con artículos guardados
description: Verifica que el carrito muestre los artículos guardados, el total y el flujo de revisión antes de pagar.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Add a template to the cart
Click the cart link
Verify cart items are displayed
Verify the cart total is displayed

title: Filtrar por Kubernetes y agregar una plantilla
description: Select the Kubernetes category for real, verify only Kubernetes templates are shown, add exactly one and verify the cart counter. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the option 'Kubernetes' in the select with data-testid=filtro-categoria
Verify every card with data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla shows category 'Kubernetes' and that 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' and 'NGINX Ingress' are visible
Verify cards for 'PostgreSQL Health', 'Node Exporter Full', 'SLO Burn Rate' and 'Blackbox Probes' are NOT visible
Click btn-agregar on exactly ONE card (Kubernetes Cluster Overview)
Verify data-testid=contador-carrito contains '(1)' and the header link reads 'Carrito (1)'

title: Ajustar cantidades y ver el total del carrito
description: Verify the numeric total in data-testid=total-carrito after changing quantity (not only the quantity). Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click btn-agregar on 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (price $15.00)
Navigate to /carrito
Verify data-testid=total-carrito contains 'Total: $15.00'
Set the input data-testid=input-cantidad to 3
Verify data-testid=input-cantidad has value 3
Verify data-testid=total-carrito contains 'Total: $45.00'

title: Cambiar cantidades en el carrito y ver el total actualizado
description: Verify the numeric total in data-testid=total-carrito after changing quantity (not only the quantity). Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click btn-agregar on 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (price $15.00)
Navigate to /carrito
Verify data-testid=total-carrito contains 'Total: $15.00'
Set the input data-testid=input-cantidad to 2
Verify data-testid=input-cantidad has value 2
Verify data-testid=total-carrito contains 'Total: $30.00'

title: Agregar una plantilla al carrito desde el catálogo
description: Verifies that a visitor can add a template from the catalog and see the cart state update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the add-to-cart control for a template
Verify the cart counter updates to reflect the added item
Open the cart
Verify the added template appears in the cart

title: Eliminar artículos hasta vaciar el carrito
description: Verifies that a buyer can remove items from the cart and see the empty state when no items remain.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Add a template to the cart
Open the cart
Remove the item from the cart
Verify the cart is empty
Verify an empty state message is displayed

title: Eliminar un artículo del carrito
description: Verifica que el usuario pueda quitar un artículo del carrito y que el carrito se actualice correctamente.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Add a template to the cart
Click the cart link
Remove the item from the cart
Verify the item is removed from the cart
Verify the cart total updates

title: Cancelar el pago y conservar el carrito
description: Verifies that canceling Stripe Checkout returns the buyer to the canceled page and keeps the cart contents intact.

steps.description: Navigate to /carrito
Add a template to the cart if needed
Start checkout
Cancel the checkout flow in Stripe
Verify the canceled page is displayed
Verify the cart contents are still preserved

title: Abrir el detalle de una plantilla y agregarla al carrito
description: Verifica que un comprador pueda abrir una plantilla válida, revisar su detalle y agregarla al carrito desde esa página.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a template detail page from the catalog
Verify the template detail page is displayed
Click add to cart on the template detail page
Verify the cart counter increases

title: Checkout real con 4242 y enlaces de descarga
description: Reach /exito through a real checkout with 4242 (no invented session_id) and verify confirmation and download links. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button with data-testid=btn-agregar on the card for 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla)
Navigate to /carrito and click the button with data-testid=btn-pagar (accessible name 'Pagar con Stripe')
On the hosted Stripe Checkout page fill email test@example.com, card number 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12 / 34, CVC 123, cardholder name 'Test User', then submit the payment
Verify the URL contains /exito?session_id= with a real session id
Verify data-testid=mensaje-exito contains 'Pago confirmado'
Verify at least one link whose accessible name starts with 'Descargar' is visible and has a href ending in '.json'

title: Explorar plantillas por categoría y abrir un detalle
description: Verifies that a visitor can filter the catalog by category and open a template detail page from the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a category filter
Verify only templates for the selected category are displayed
Click a template card to open its detail page
Verify the template detail page is displayed

title: Conservar el carrito al cancelar el checkout
description: Verifica que cancelar el pago regrese al usuario a la tienda sin perder los artículos del carrito.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Add a template to the cart
Start the checkout flow from the cart
Cancel the checkout flow
Verify the cart still contains the previously selected item
Verify the cart counter remains populated

title: Agregar una plantilla al carrito desde el detalle
description: Verifies that a user can add a template from its detail page and return to a cart that contains the item.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a template card to open its detail page
Click the add-to-cart control on the detail page
Open the cart
Verify the selected template is present in the cart

title: Tarjeta rechazada no redirige a /exito
description: Declined card 4000 0000 0000 0002: Stripe shows an error and the app does not reach /exito. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button with data-testid=btn-agregar on the card for 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla)
Navigate to /carrito and click the button with data-testid=btn-pagar (accessible name 'Pagar con Stripe')
On the hosted Stripe Checkout page fill email test@example.com, card number 4000 0000 0000 0002, expiry 12 / 34, CVC 123, cardholder name 'Test User', then submit the payment
Verify Stripe Checkout shows a card declined error message (text containing 'declined' or 'rechaz')
Verify the URL does not contain /exito

title: 3D Secure con 4000 0025 0000 3155 llega a Pago confirmado
description: 3D Secure card: complete the authentication challenge and reach the confirmed payment page. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

Click the button with data-testid=btn-agregar on the card for 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' (data-testid=tarjeta-plantilla)
Navigate to /carrito and click the button with data-testid=btn-pagar (accessible name 'Pagar con Stripe')
On the hosted Stripe Checkout page fill email test@example.com, card number 4000 0025 0000 3155, expiry 12 / 34, CVC 123, cardholder name 'Test User', then submit the payment
In the Stripe 3D Secure test authentication frame/page click the button that completes authentication (e.g. 'Complete')

title: /exito sin session_id muestra error de confirmación
description: Open /exito without session_id. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /exito
Verify data-testid=mensaje-error-pago is visible and contains 'No pudimos confirmar tu pago'
Verify the text 'Pago confirmado' is not present

title: /plantillas/no-existe muestra la página 404
description: Open a non-existent template id. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Navigate to /plantillas/no-existe
Verify the 404 not-found page is shown (heading or text indicating the page was not found)
Verify no template detail or btn-agregar is shown

title: Descarga directa de la plantilla sin pagar no se entrega
description: Without buying anything, request the JSON file directly; downloads must only be available after payment. Use stable locators only (data-testid or role + accessible name); no absolute XPath and no Stripe CSS classes.

steps.description: Without adding anything to the cart or paying, open http://localhost:3002/plantillas/kubernetes-cluster-overview.json directly
Verify the response does NOT deliver the template JSON (expected: 404/403 or a not-found/blocked page, and the body must not contain a Grafana dashboard definition)

title: Ver un estado no confirmado en la página de éxito
description: Verifies that the success page shows an unresolved payment state when it cannot confirm a completed purchase session.

steps.description: Navigate to /exito without a session identifier
Verify a payment could not be confirmed message is visible

title: Mostrar una página 404 para una plantilla inexistente
description: Verifica que visitar un identificador de plantilla inválido muestre una página 404.

steps.description: Navigate to a nonexistent template detail page
Verify a 404 page is displayed

title: Abrir un detalle de plantilla inexistente
description: Verifies that an invalid template detail route shows a not found state.

steps.description: Navigate to /plantillas/invalid-id
Verify a not found state is displayed

title: Verify the app health endpoint returns an OK status
description: This test verifies that the health check endpoint responds with an OK status for a running application.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/health
Verify a status response is displayed
Verify the status indicates the application is healthy
